credits_text: Natsumi Horie, Shiho Obita, Yoshinori Dekura, Masato Yasukawa, Hiroshi Okada and more... Screenplay/Director: Hiroshi Okada with HOUND PROJECT
other_text: Since ancient times, there have been legends of immortal monsters that feed on human flesh and blood. Vampires, werewolves... And in this country, we called that monster 'One'
